method: Table-specific producer review plus stock union definitions, actual alternative writer/API review and readonly committed251 observations. No core or repo edits; coordinator chooses batched schema boundary.

rows.retained_alternative: string_value length; string_unit ordered target bytes; constant literal prefix/flags
rows.notes: EDG provides target machine bytes, including embedded/multiple/no NUL; no canonical Unicode string. Remove unused Text shortcut and reader text-reencoding branch; preserve exact bytes.

rows.retained_alternative: from/to constant values and types; occurrence constant_component; embedded address_value.offset
rows.notes: Stock payload is a pair of symbolic label addresses, no computed numeric difference. Do not infer target instruction offsets.

rows.retained_alternative: constant occurrence initialized_field_id/initialized_base_subobject_id for optimized empty objects; designator_value.field_id when present
rows.notes: Ordinary aggregate list elements are constants; no per-element direct field. Existing ordered occurrence relation preserves next order without field assignment inference.
Do not duplicate dynamic initialization edge onto every aggregate-element row.

rows.retained_alternative: designator_subscript ordered constant values/types (generic range has two); resolved repeated ranges use ck_init_repeat count and tail flag
rows.notes: No direct range-end field in EDG designator union. Do not derive scalar endpoints from dependent expressions.

rows.retained_alternative: next ordered constant occurrence/aggregate_element contains designated initializer; generic subscript values in designator_subscript
rows.notes: Stock explicitly says designated field/element initialized by constant pointed to by next. Value interned separately; preserve occurrence ordering.

rows.retained_alternative: constant.type_id/orig_type_id on occurrence; designator_subscript.type_id for generic endpoints; aggregate_element.type_id for element
rows.notes: No singular type payload field in designator union.

rows.retained_alternative: parameter coordinates, actual expression/type/constant operands and lists; occurrence source_correspondence semantic owner/name
rows.notes: tpck_member explicitly has no variant; unknown_function.symbol is explicitly frontend-only and cannot be used in backend. No synthetic symbol resolution.

rows.retained_alternative: template_argument.constant_id -> constant.backing_expression_id and contextual local_expression_reference; dependent-value expression when present
rows.notes: No expression arm in template_arg; arg_operand expressly frontend-only. Optional convenience Expression must not claim a different independent EDG field.

rows.retained_alternative: template_header.requires_clause_id; requires_clause expression; concept template_definition.constraint_id; routine-type requires clauses
rows.notes: Synthetic template_specialization row reflects retained is_specialized flag and actual entity. No independent constraint field exists there. Do not copy primary constraint as if it were specialized selection result.

limits: All candidates are unwritten; zero observations alone were not used as removal justification.
Alternatives are direct retained links/order, not semantic reconstruction.
Review does not assert that every adjacent conditional alternative already has positive fixture evidence.
